implementation_files.role: Collect Python import, export, and symbol-use facts
Resolve Python cross-file imports and repoint sourceless references/inheritance stubs
Order cross-file Python import resolution before generic unique-stub rewiring

important_implementation_constraints: Repointing applies only to sourceless target stubs; already source-backed targets are not rewritten by this pass.
The older cross-file inferred uses mechanism is separate from canonical type/inheritance target repointing.
Absolute-import fallback logic can be ambiguous; verify exact module+symbol selection on each fixture rather than relying on bare-name resolution.
Python inherited-method call lookup explicitly stops when a class has two or more bases because cross-file MRO ordering is not modelled.
